uiApproach: XML layouts + RecyclerView (no Jetpack Compose, no Leanback widgets)
notes: No third-party logos/screenshots are bundled. All on-screen content (icons, labels, cards, badges) is driven by app/src/main/assets/home_data.json. When an item has no iconUrl, a deterministic letter-avatar placeholder is rendered instead.

root.searchHint: string, shown in the static search bar row
root.rows: array of Row objects, rendered top to bottom in that order

row.title: string or null — row header text; null hides the header
row.type: one of: icons | search | chips | cards
row.items: array of Item objects (empty for type=search)

item.label: string, display name
item.iconUrl: string or empty — remote image URL loaded via Glide
item.badge: string or null — small overlay label, e.g. FREE
item.placeholderColor: hex string or null — background color for the letter-avatar fallback
